lines.text: Amos sees a basket of summer fruit, and the LORD says the end has come for Israel.
Those who trample the needy want the Sabbath over so they can sell wheat, buying the poor for a pair of sandals.
The LORD swears He will never forget their deeds, and the land will swell and subside like the Euphrates.
The LORD says He will make the sun go down at noon and turn feasts into mourning.
The LORD will send a famine of hearing His words, and those who swear by Samaria's guilt will fall, never to rise.
